privacy.title: Privacy & data exports
privacy.intro: Request a copy of the data we hold about you under GDPR. Exports are retained for 24 hours and then deleted automatically.
privacy.requestBody: We'll prepare a ZIP archive of every record we hold against your account and email you when it's ready.
privacy.downloadBody: The download link is generated on demand and tied to your signed-in session.

status.queued: Export queued. You will receive an email when it is ready to download.
status.invalidUrl: Server returned an invalid download URL
status.downloadStarting: Download starting. The link expires in 15 minutes — request a new one if you need to download again later.
status.noExport: No export is ready yet. Request one above and wait for the email.
